authentication: RunLater signed request v1; Ed25519 exact body digest, origin, project/key, method/path, timestamps, nonce and idempotency key
constraints: url is required for create and forbidden for all other destination commands
revoke checks the named version exists, then revokes the whole endpoint across all versions
operator-approved exact HTTPS host allowlist is separate from ownership proof; arbitrary customer hosts remain disabled
prepare returns proof response once; verify fetches the approved endpoint and never trusts a caller-supplied verification response
source contract is not a declaration that these endpoints are deployed or authorized
task_request: Existing task DTO: destination registered:<endpoint_id>, body, operation_key, optional run_at_ms. Server atomically snapshots the latest registered version; redrive preserves the source version. No caller URL is accepted in a task.
fresh_admission: Requires explicitly configured invitation delivery, verified destination, active signer/material and finite enrolled grant; otherwise fails closed. Live alpha unchanged.
